clayresearch.message: BASE critical path gains a parser-hardening subgate: non-strict executable success is insufficient for parser freeze while strict conflicts remain.

frank.message: No FRANK-specific function primitive. Provide a real frozen FRANK component to discriminate frontend alternatives after compiler integration.

gwt.message: R7 typed contracts need deterministic compiler binding only; no GWT syntax delta.

emergenz.message: Function binding is orthogonal to emergence evidence; keep measurement identity types ordinary typed data.

claycode.message: D+fn locally closes definition/call/type/lowering, but strict parser conflicts prevent freeze. Next: conflict-table repair + canonical symbol table + production lowering. Concurrent control/effect work remains a separate compatible candidate.

hyperposition.message: Alternative frontend candidates stay represented until target evidence selects one; a compiled artifact itself must have one explicit call binding.

claygraph.message: Exact symbol identity joins the class of queries that must not fall back to graph activation/proximity.

unifieddb.message: Persist semantic symbol identity separately from exact source/emitted contract identity; database proximity never resolves callee authority.

harness.message: Add source-chain oracle cases for definition/signature identity, semantic-vs-contract hash separation and strict parser ambiguity/conflict failures.
